stemMd: Why are strength and water absorption discussed separately from colour?

options.label: A
options.textMd: To show recycled tiles cannot be tested.

options.label: B
options.textMd: To prove that colour never affects a purchase decision.

options.label: C
options.textMd: To distinguish functional adequacy from an aesthetic preference.

options.label: D
options.textMd: To establish that every conventional tile is stronger.

options.label: E
options.textMd: To remove responsibility for describing the product.

explanationMd: Colour variation may be a legitimate design choice, but performance standards still constrain usability. Keeping the questions separate prevents aesthetic acceptance from being used to excuse functional defects, or visual difference from automatically implying poor performance.

distractorRationale.b: The client’s concern shows it can matter.
distractorRationale.a: The studio performs and publishes tests.
distractorRationale.d: No such comparative result is given.
